result: Added a "Reset Health" button to `scripts/player.gd` via `@export_tool_button`, which calls a new `reset_health()` that sets `health` to `max_health` and emits `health_changed`; I also added `@tool` and an `Engine.is_editor_hint()` guard in `_physics_process` so the button works in the editor without running gameplay there. Godot review reports 0 errors (not run in the engine).
